next_step: Deliver POC report + latency benchmarks; schedule security deep-dive with infra team
notes:
Background: Nebula Devsuite builds an IDE-integrated copilot and repo-level search for engineering teams. They want repository-aware retrieval (embeddings + vector DB) with strict residency for EU customers.

Key quotes: "We need completions that feel instant — P95 <= 80ms for local dev, off-host streaming ok but should be seamless." — CTO (Elena Morales).

Technical constraints: prefer syntax-aware chunking (AST or tree-based splits), ability to index repo history and multiple branches, upsert latency < 1s for new commits in POC, vector DB must be hosted in EU or air-gapped on-prem option. Want model pinning per workspace and version fallback rules.

POC goals: ingest 3 medium repos (~40k LOC each), measure recall for context retrieval (target R@5 >= 0.9 for top-10 windows), end-to-end suggestion latency < 120ms (goal <80ms) for single-thread completions, throughput for 200 concurrent devs (burst to 500). Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay for Dedicated/Private if latency and residency guaranteed.

Security ask: SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS integration, audit logging for token-level access, 12 month retention controls and ability to purge per-customer. Legal needs standard DPA + Data Processing Addendum with EU residency clause.

Stated preferences: avoid closed hosted-only vector DBs; lean to Redwood Dedicated or Private with Weaviate/FAISS backend. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching/kv-cache for IDE streaming.

Short wins: Redwood provide sample ingestion script, quick latency runbook, list of verified model variants and quantized profile that balance cost/latency.

Sales notes: account receptive, influential champion in platform team (VP Eng). Budget conversation started. Procurement timeline dependent on SOC2 and legal review.
